description: A Drupal core class defining a context wrapper for plugin contexts, managing context data, definitions, cacheability, and dependencies.

classes.name: Drupal\Core\Plugin\Context\Context
classes.description: A Drupal specific context wrapper class managing context data, definitions, cacheability, and dependencies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the context with a definition and optional value, setting up cache metadata.

methods.name: getContextValue
methods.description: Retrieves the context value, using default if not set, or throws exception if required and missing.

methods.name: hasContextValue
methods.description: Checks if the context has a value.

methods.name: setContextValue
methods.description: Sets the context value, adding cache dependencies if applicable.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Returns constraints from the context definition.

methods.name: getContextData
methods.description: Returns the context data, creating default if not set.

methods.name: addCacheableDependency
methods.description: Adds a cacheable dependency to the cache metadata.

methods.name: getCacheContexts
methods.description: Returns cache contexts from cache metadata.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags from cache metadata.

methods.name: getCacheMaxAge
methods.description: Returns cache max age from cache metadata.

methods.name: createFromContext
methods.description: Creates a new context from an existing one with a new value, copying dependencies.
